### 00:30-00:49 UTC - UI Task 8 review fix round 1/5

- Same owned worktree/branch, FIX_BASE `e543b5b8`; read `/tmp/opencode/launchloom-admin-task-8-review.md`. Receipt commit `84ae10e8` retained but no new receipt added. No subagents, push, merge, deploy, live data, secrets or Nifty writes.
- Added a compact Generations attention summary backed by two real full-dataset server totals (`executionStatus=failed` and `executionStatus=unknown`, each `limit=1`). It shows Failed/Unknown Attempts plus `View failures` / `View unknown` actions, never an estimate, and states that server totals may omit attempts while health coverage is partial or unknown. Browser test asserts the server arguments, counts, partial-coverage caveat and the filtered failures view.
- Honesty fix: `unknown` execution and any stale attempt with a start timestamp but no completion now render elapsed time as `Not recorded`, never `In progress`. `data-attempt-elapsed` gives the regression a stable target.
- Cursor-history fix: the page trail now lives in `history.state` (`cursorTrail`) instead of local component state. Initial/sidebar/filter/attention/cross-view navigation resets it; next pushes the current cursor; previous pops it; popstate restores the exact trail. Browser regression pages to `offset:200`, walks back to page one (Previous disabled), forward through page two/three and back, then uses Previous without sending a stale or duplicate cursor.
- A11y fix: only the expanded row carries `aria-controls` for its inspector in both views. Cross-view navigation resets the cursor trail so a client-page stack cannot leak into a generations page.

### 01:27 UTC - UI Task 9 partial (Access mode, unblocked surfaces)

- Nifty subtask reference `7NFDlTJsXa` remains open. Per the dispatch boundary, no Nifty write, completion receipt, push, merge, deploy, provisioning, secret access, live client data or paid-provider call was made.
- Worktree `/home/maigreeks/projects/.worktrees/launchloom-admin-ui-task9`, branch `codex/launchloom-admin-ui-task9`, BASE controller head `8d4c7605`. Tasks 1-3 and UI 7-8 contracts preserved. GenerationsView/ClientsView were not modified.
- Outcome: Invitations now uses the existing authenticated legacy API `/api/admin/onboarding-invites` for GET list and POST create/revoke/backfill/recover-intake. The view shows expiry/status/creator (missing creator -> `Not recorded`), creates optional client-email invitations, displays the generated link once from in-memory state with copy and manual-copy fallback, and never stores the link/token in localStorage, sessionStorage, cookies, URL, console or analytics. Create is guarded against rapid double submission; network/5xx/ambiguous results block another create until a successful list readback. Revoke requires contextual confirmation; backfill reports updated/remaining counts; recovery requires selecting an invitation, entering an explicitly reviewed issue number and checking the confirmation box. Request bodies contain only the legacy action fields, never browser-supplied actor/creator identity. Ambiguous revoke/backfill/recovery responses refresh the list rather than retrying blindly.
- Interim identity: added the narrow authenticated `GET /api/admin/onboarding-invites/workspace/me` contract. In Access mode, after existing origin, audience and allowlist verification, it returns `{principal:{id:"access:<sha256 of lowercase verified email>",email,displayName:null,role:"admin",authSource:"cloudflare-access"}}`. No membership record is created, no owner role is inferred and no browser identity is accepted. Missing identity returns 401, a denied email/audience returns 403, and `ADMIN_AUTH_MODE=neon` returns 503 `{error:{code:"not_enabled",message:"Persistent account profiles are not enabled."}}` instead of a fake profile. Settings displays this identity read-only (email read-only, name `Name not recorded`) with the explicit notice `Persistent account profiles are not enabled yet.`
- Blocked account scope: Team shows `Administrator accounts are not configured yet` with no member, invitation, role or owner controls and makes no API call. No sign-up, sign-in, password reset, profile save, membership or Neon call was added. GHL shows exactly one `Not connected`, `Planned`, and a disabled `Connection coming later` button; it makes no provider or third-party request.
